judgments.reason: The span 'IgG kappa plasma cell myeloma' appears literally in the clinical record and directly identifies the primary malignancy, clinically supporting the etiology component of the completed diagnosis label.

The span 'a 35 mm lesion in the right hepatic lobe showed an SUVmax of 6.1' appears literally in the clinical record and supports hepatic involvement (anatomy) by the known plasma cell myeloma, consistent with the metastatic-to-liver modifier.

The span 'a 17 mm lesion in segment VI with moderately increased T2 signal, decreased T1 signal, weak heterogeneous contrast enhancement, and restricted diffusion, favoring a non-characteristic malignant lesion' appears literally in the clinical record and supports a malignant hepatic lesion (anatomy), clinically consistent with metastatic plasma cell myeloma to the liver.
